name: Kairouan
description: Kairouan is a walled city in central Tunisia, founded around 670 and long regarded as the Maghreb's holiest city, a status it kept even after political power moved to Tunis. Its Great Mosque is the main sight, with a forest of marble and porphyry columns inside. The 9th-century Mosque of the Three Gates is also worth seeking out, as the city reached its peak under the Aghlabid dynasty.
